_comment: MEASURED FITNESS, kept BESIDE the standard rather than inside it. `standard_hash` covers standard.json's bytes and a citation resolves through it, so a measurement taken after publication must not invalidate every citation made against v1.0 — the same reason applicability.json is a sidecar (G-10, v3.1 CP3). The published site reads THIS file; no number on the site is hand-copied. If a sample is absent here the site says so rather than inventing one.

samples.name: general
samples.label: General DTC sample
samples.description: Stores captured without regard to category — the shape a broad fitness sweep produces.
samples.method: Every pass_evidenced row audited individually against its full untruncated evidence. The 95% upper bound is the rule of three inflated by a design effect for clustering within store (ICC 0.2), because pass rows are not independent — they share a store's copy conventions.

pending.coffee: Re-measurement on an expanded coffee sample is in progress; until it lands the site publishes no category bound rather than the stale n=69 figure.
